## Objective
Measure executable capacity across capital scales using real tick/L2/ADV and venue fill data, instead of linear OHLCV extrapolation.

## Owning authority
- V8_Profesyonel_Benchmark_Arastirmasi.pdf, capacity section.
- docs/issues/ISSUE_AUD008_MAKER_FILL_PROBABILITY_AND_ADVERSE_SELECTION.md
- docs/issues/ISSUE_AUD009A_STATIC_CAPITAL_VIABILITY_ENVELOPE.md
- D-116 and Rule 30 friction reality.

## Change class
BENCHMARK_EVALUATION

## Current state / Null hypothesis
v8-next emits 1x/10x/100x rows as accounting extrapolations. One-hour OHLCV lacks depth, spread, queue position, participation, intraday impact, and nonlinear liquidity information, so preserved-edge capacity is explicitly unvalidated.

## Required end state / Challenger hypothesis
H1 — With a declared venue/instrument/time window, order size and participation materially affect fill probability, shortfall, and net portfolio outcome.
H0 — If L2/tick/ADV/venue fill data are absent or not identifiable, the capacity result is DATA_BLOCKED and no coefficient is invented.
End state: report scale-specific fill, impact, spread, participation, capacity floor, and uncertainty.

## Expected file / module surface
v8-next/src/v8_next/evaluation/capacity.py (new)
v8-next/src/v8_next/evaluation/economic_benchmark.py
v8-next/src/v8_next/adapters/shadow_ingest.py
v8-next/tests/test_capacity.py (new)
research manifests and reports

## Verification gates
Require real sequenced trade/quote/L2 data; validate price-time ordering, venue constraints, participation and impact calibration, scale monotonicity, sensitivity, and missing-data refusal. No synthetic series outside isolated tests.

## Required evidence artifacts
L2/tick/ADV manifest; venue metadata; fill and rejection ledger; impact/slippage model receipt; scale sweep results; uncertainty and DATA_BLOCKED report.

## Non-goals / forbidden scope
No linear extrapolation presented as validation, no invented impact coefficients, no strategy tuning to pass capacity, no production capital decision.

### Context-completeness contract

### 11. Normative Traceability
R1 — Capacity is a venue/data-dependent claim. Authority: PDF capacity limits.
R2 — Impact and participation require identifiable microstructure data.
R3 — A model output is not venue validation without observed fills.

### 12. Existing Types / Interfaces to Reuse
Reuse capacity_scenarios schema, ArtifactBinding, venue metadata, shadow fills, portfolio account ledger, and NO_ECONOMIC_CLAIM.

### 13. Mathematical / Semantic Invariants
I1: no L2/tick/ADV input means no capacity coefficient.
I2: cost/impact components are not double counted.
I3: scale changes preserve declared order intent and record changed fill behavior.

### 14. Canonical Failure Semantics
Missing microstructure data -> DATA_BLOCKED.
Non-identifiable model -> UNRESOLVED.
Nonfinite/invalid book -> INVALID.
Any positive output remains NO_ECONOMIC_CLAIM.

### 15. Dependency Map
microstructure capture -> calibration -> scale scenario replay -> capacity evidence -> report; no capital authority.

### 16. Ambiguity / OPEN_PIN Triggers
- If the estimand, authority, or data role is ambiguous, STOP and open an OPEN_PIN.
- If the required source data is unavailable, report DATA_BLOCKED; do not manufacture observations.
- If a result could be interpreted as an economic claim, keep it NO_ECONOMIC_CLAIM.

### References / sources / attachments
Related: AUD-008, AUD-009A. Current economic_benchmark.py explicitly marks capacity as UNMODELED.

### V8 guards
- [x] I will not fabricate, hardcode, or synthesize statistical metrics.
- [x] Constitution Rule 12 (NO_ECONOMIC_CLAIM) remains binding without certified authority receipts.
- [x] Frozen OOS will not be opened without explicit pre-authorization.
- [x] If statistical methodology or data authority is ambiguous, I will open/escalate an OPEN_PIN.
